_note: All names, companies, emails and amounts in this demo are invented. Email domains use the reserved example.com/.net/.org namespaces.

clients.name: Harbor & Pine Roofing
clients.summary: $150 per booked call that takes place; no-shows free
terms_text: §1 $150 per booked sales call that takes place.
§3 A rescheduled call is billed once, when it takes place.
§4 A call Harbor & Pine cancels with less than 24 hours notice is billed; earlier cancellations are free. Cancellations by the homeowner are free.

clients.name: Cobalt Dental Studio
clients.summary: $1,200 monthly retainer plus $45 per qualified lead
terms_text: §2 $45 per qualified lead: a new-patient inquiry the studio marks Qualified, with insurance or a budget confirmed.
§3 The same person (same email address) counts once per month.
§4 Leads the studio marks Unqualified, or has not reviewed yet, are not billed.

clients.name: Mesa Ridge Solar
clients.summary: $200 per in-home consultation, $250 from the 9th; no-shows free if reported within 48h
terms_text: §1 $200 per in-home consultation that takes place. From the 9th billable consultation in a month, $250 each.
§2 A no-show is free if Mesa Ridge reports it within 48 hours of the appointment time. A no-show reported later is billed.
